tagline: Multi-Process Custom Coating in Central Pennsylvania

why_choose_us.title: Five coating processes under one roof
why_choose_us.description: Autophoretic, powder, zinc plating, batch paint and dip coating — plus fabrication, assembly, burn-off, blasting and lab testing. One vendor instead of four, and no seams between them for you to own.

why_choose_us.title: An onsite coating laboratory
why_choose_us.description: We run our own state-of-the-art lab and issue certifications of the process and the performance criteria. When your spec needs documentation, you get paperwork, not a verbal assurance.

why_choose_us.title: One piece to entire truckloads
why_choose_us.description: We process orders ranging from a single part to full truckloads daily. Prototype runs and short batches get quoted, not turned away.

why_choose_us.title: Our own fleet, off Interstate 80
why_choose_us.description: Three trucks — two tractor trailers and one straight-side closed van — plus custom packaging and expedite service when a line is waiting on parts.
